method: Manually read every source-to-foreground assignment and reviewed the actual image types already inspected in stills/exports. Focus: semantic contradictions, neighboring-sentence carryover, explicit labels, sensitive personal inferences and foreign illustrative settings. Not an automatic source/hash recheck.
findings: No contradictory permission/prohibition/eligibility/consent labels. Contextual photographs/flags are not presented as evidence of a particular person’s status or a specific legal incident. Every image is uncaptained; provenance/context retained in assets and credits.
